problems: WebFetch returns a model-written extract of each page, not the raw text; quoted phrases in the notes are the extract's own where it used quotation marks, otherwise paraphrase.
Three Wikipedia titles did not load (not found): Bharashiva_dynasty, Pawaya, Padmavati_(ancient_city); Ikshvaku_dynasty loads but covers only the mythical dynasty (cited as thin in andhra-ikshvaku).

Four dossiers run well into the sa-03 period: western-ganga-dynasty (350-999), later-gupta-dynasty (490-750), kalachuris-of-mahishmati (550-625) and vishnukundina-dynasty (420-624). sa-03 and sa-03-x were told in sa-02-d's notes to consider them; if sa-03-x also writes one of these slugs, keep the one that validates and merge the events.

Other dossiers need matching events: kadamba-empire (found 345 at Banavasi should name chutu-dynasty), satavahana-dynasty (vassal_start c. 125 and vassal_end c. 225 for chutu-dynasty), gupta-empire (loss of Kalinga to mathara-dynasty c. 350, Andhra to andhra-ikshvaku/salankayana), rashtrakuta-dynasty (vassal_start of western-ganga-dynasty 819-973), late-pallava-empire (gain from andhra-ikshvaku c. 325), alchon-huns (counterpart aulikara-dynasty), anuradhapura (ruhuna slug, matches).
The slug ruhuna was chosen on purpose (the dossier name is Ruhuna) to match the counterpart string already used by anuradhapura; slugify(Kingdom of Ruhuna) would have been kingdom-of-ruhuna.

Counterparts used that still have no dossier: pitrbhakta-dynasty, pushyabhuti-dynasty, panduvamshi-dynasty, mauryas-of-puri, eastern-chalukyas, maukhari-dynasty (sa-03-a), harsha-s-empire/kannauj-varman-dynasty (sa-03). The validator warns for two of them (pitrbhakta-dynasty, pushyabhuti-dynasty).
Capital coordinates for new states are mostly approximate (the Wikipedia extracts give none) and are flagged in each capital note.
